WITH major_member_counts AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_major AS major_id,
        COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        member_count,
        CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction
    FROM major_member_counts
)
SELECT major_id, member_count, fraction
FROM ranked
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
